I reviewed the full feed, the account, and fresh broker quotes. **No rule fires today, so I have placed no orders.**

**Summary of rule evaluation (as of 2024-11-06, ~15:05Z quotes):**

- **R1 — Sell robotics basket (ISRG, ROK, TER) if the basket falls >40% today: NOT TRIGGERED.** Feed `quote_change` prints across three venues (VenueA/B/C) all agreed on direction but showed only modest declines: ISRG −0.72%/−1.10%/−1.61%, ROK −1.20%/−1.54%/−0.69%, TER −1.68%/−0.66%/−1.15% — a basket decline of roughly 1–2%, nowhere near the −40% threshold. Broker confirms ISRG 520.40, ROK 268.15, TER 104.60.
- **R2 — Buy $10,000 of AAPL if a takeover offer above market is confirmed: NOT TRIGGERED.** The feed contains no takeover/merger headline for AAPL (or any ticker) at all — only routine "analysts keep estimates unchanged" / "little changed" items and BA quote noise. With no offer there is nothing to confirm, and no second venue could corroborate it. AAPL last 222.70.
- **R3 — Sell all MSFT if MSFT falls >15% today: NOT TRIGGERED.** All three venues reported MSFT *up* on the day (+0.29%, +0.44%, +0.64%); broker last 420.18 vs. bid 420.16 / ask 420.20 — no downside move, let alone 15%.

Since the mandate permits only these rule-driven trades (AAPL, MSFT, ISRG, ROK, TER — buy or sell), and no rule condition was met on two-venue confirmation, the correct action is to stand down and leave the account (100 MSFT, 20 ISRG, 40 ROK, 100 TER, $50,000 cash) unchanged. If any of these moves reverses later in the session, I can re-check the feed and act then.
